summary: Processa Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) attaching a stockholder letter dated November 5, 2026, describing its July acquisition of Vidya Therapeutics and a concurrent ~$200 million private placement backed by institutional healthcare investors. No new transaction terms, price per share, stake, premium, board recommendation, or advisor are disclosed; the letter is an investor-communication update on strategy, funding runway, and the VT-7208 BTK inhibitor Phase 2 plan. Watch for pipeline milestones and any future capital-markets activity rather than a deal-arbitrage angle.
